sourceCopy.name: Push-Up Test & Set Tracker
sourceCopy.title: Push-Up Test & Set Tracker Free | UsefulVerse
sourceCopy.description: Log manually counted push-up sets, rest and progress. Free, private and optional local history; no camera needed.
sourceCopy.intro: Record a single set as a simple test or log several sets with the rest between them. You count and enter repetitions; this tool does not use your camera or rank your strength.
sourceCopy.howQuestion: How does the push-up test tracker total repetitions?
sourceCopy.howAnswer: It adds the whole-number repetitions entered for each non-empty set. Blank lines are ignored, a set of zero remains zero, and the rest estimate is rest per break multiplied by the number of breaks.
sourceCopy.privacyAnswer: No. The calculation runs in this browser. Session history is written to this device only after you opt in; you can delete it here.

fields.repsInput: Repetitions for each set, one number per line
fields.repsHint: Enter up to 20 whole-number counts from 0 to 500. Blank lines are ignored and do not count as sets. Count only repetitions you completed with your chosen form.
fields.notesHint: Keep notes general; this is not a medical record.
fields.safetyNote: Choose a comfortable range of motion and stop if you feel pain, dizziness or unusual shortness of breath. Rep counts depend on form, pace and test conditions; this tool does not provide a fitness rating, diagnosis or exercise prescription.
fields.saveConsent: Save this session and recent history on this device
fields.privacyNote: Saving is optional and uses this browser only. Uncheck to calculate without saving, or clear the saved history below.
fields.chartDescription: Total manually counted push-ups in recent saved sessions

messages.checkInputs: Check the set counts, date and rest value.
messages.copyUnavailable: Copy is not available in this browser.
messages.saveUnavailable: This browser could not access local storage.
messages.deleted: Saved session history deleted from this device.

additionalFaqs.question: Do blank lines count as a set or repetition?
additionalFaqs.answer: No. Empty lines are ignored. A line with 0 records a zero-repetition set and adds no repetitions to the total.

additionalFaqs.question: Can I use this for one maximum set or for several sets?
additionalFaqs.answer: Yes. Enter one line for a single manually counted set, or multiple lines to summarize sets and the rest between them. Test conditions are up to you; results are not compared with population norms.

additionalFaqs.question: Is my training history uploaded?
additionalFaqs.answer: No. History is optional and stays in this browser on this device. Clear it with the delete button whenever you want.
